name: cloudflare-deploy
description: Deploy Cloudflare Workers and set up CI/CD: wrangler deploy, build-on-push via GitHub Actions or the native Workers Builds REST API, and Deploy Hooks. Cloudflare constellation satellite.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Scoped Cloudflare API token with Workers Scripts Edit and Workers Routes Edit

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Account ID wrangler deploys to (or set account_id in wrangler config)

node.description: Node.js runtime — provides npx to run wrangler.

npx.description: npx — runs wrangler (npx wrangler deploy) without a global install.

curl.description: curl — POSTs to Workers Builds Deploy Hooks and calls the Builds REST API.
